_meta.dataset: CITES-listed Indian medicinal / aromatic plants relevant to IP-SAKTI Sahayak formulations

annotation_key.#2: All parts and derivatives except: (a) seeds and pollen; and (b) finished products packaged and ready for retail trade.
annotation_key.#14: All parts and derivatives except: (a) seeds, spores and pollen (including pollinia); (b) seedling or tissue cultures obtained in vitro, in solid or liquid media, transported in sterile containers; (c) fruits, and parts and derivatives thereof, of artificially propagated plants; and (d) finished products packaged and ready for retail trade.

_meta.disclaimer: This is decision-support reference data mirrored from the CITES Appendices and MoEF&CC guidance. It is not a legal export/import opinion — always obtain current CITES permit advice from the CITES Management Authority in India.
_verified_sources: MoEF&CC list of 113 CITES-listed species requiring Certificate of Cultivation / Legal Procurement
EXIM Policy — export of whole plants of listed species prohibited
Gowthami et al. 2021, Genetic Resources and Crop Evolution (consolidated CITES list of Indian medicinal plants)

plants.impact: ONLY Indian medicinal plant in CITES Appendix I. International trade in wild specimens is prohibited except in exceptional circumstances with import/export permits from both parties.
plants.permit_requirement: CITES import + export permits for any commercial movement; effectively a trade ban for wild-harvested root.
plants.india_controls: Schedule VI Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972; export of kuth roots prohibited under EXIM Policy unless cultivated with Certificate of Cultivation.
plants.cultivation_note: Cultivated kuth from registered farms may move with Certificate of Cultivation / Legal Procurement Certificate from State Forest Department — requires full provenance documentation.

plants.impact: Appendix II: trade allowed but regulated — export/import needs a CITES permit; exporter must prove legal provenance.
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit required for international movement of whole/sliced roots and derivatives.
plants.india_controls: EXIM Policy bans export of raw wild jatamansi; Certificate of Cultivation required for cultivated material.
plants.cultivation_note: Prioritize cultivated/biodiversity-registered stock; document origin to avoid seizure at customs.

plants.impact: Appendix II — international trade regulated (enforced since CoP10, 1997).
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit for international movement.
plants.india_controls: Wild harvest & export restricted; cultivate-and-certify path recommended.
plants.cultivation_note: Cultivated kutki acceptable with Certificate of Cultivation; verify supplier holds legal procurement records.

verified_wild_caught_sources: Sub-Himalayan tracts, Western Ghats, NE India forests
plants.impact: Appendix II — heavily traded root; legal procurement + CITES export permit mandatory for international transfer.
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit; Legal Procurement Certificate from State Forest Department for wild origin.
plants.india_controls: Endangered under IUCN; EXIM Policy export restrictions; harvested mainly for reserpine alkaloid.
plants.cultivation_note: Cultivated sarpagandha from medicinal-plant boards is the compliant sourcing route.

plants.impact: Appendix II — whole trees/bark/derivatives regulated; source for taxol/paclitaxel extraction.
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit for bark/needle movement; proof of cultivation or legal forestry origin.
plants.india_controls: Harvest restrictions under State Forest Departments; often under Schedule of WLPA at state level.
plants.cultivation_note: Plantations/clonal origin with documented chain-of-custody accepted.

plants.impact: Appendix II — regulated rhizome trade; source of podophyllotoxin (anticancer precursor).
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit for wild-collected rhizome.
plants.cultivation_note: Ex-situ cultivated or licensed nursery source required for compliant supply.

plants.impact: Appendix II — source of diosgenin (steroid hormone precursor); regulated wild tuber trade.
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit; Legal Procurement Certificate for wild origin.
plants.india_controls: EXIM Policy excludes wild-collected tubers from free export.
plants.cultivation_note: Cultivated or certified wild-harvest only; maintain provenance records.

plants.impact: Appendix II — entire species genus-regulated; agarwood resin/oil movement requires permits.
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit for resin/heartwood; imports require verifying exporting Party permit.
plants.india_controls: Cultivation promotion under CSIR/ICFRE; still export-regulated to protect wild populations.
plants.cultivation_note: Provenance from plantations + registered inventory critical; agar oil and chips both in-scope.

plants.impact: Appendix II — well-known for smuggling-linked trade; strict export control context.
plants.permit_requirement: CITES export permit for heartwood and products; strong chain-of-custody proof.
plants.india_controls: A.P. forest department monopoly on sandalwood sales; e-auction of legal stock.
plants.cultivation_note: Only legally e-auctioned / cultivated stock is exportable.

plants.india_controls: Kin now heavily restricted; licensed collection only.
plants.cultivation_note: Rare in trade; verify legitimate nursery origin.

plants.impact: Appendix II — cycad family regulated for ornamental/medicinal use.
plants.india_controls: Endemic & limited range; licensed nursery propagation only.
